common.title: Adoption Delivers
common.line: Public-sector AI adoption produces visible, measurable benefit – waiting lists that fall, decisions that arrive in days rather than months, teaching that demonstrably works – and it is attributed to a European decision rather than to an American product.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Clinical open model pullback
notable.line: Several showcase hospital networks disconnect locally-run open frontier models after a hygiene-check failure exposes patient data to model exfiltration, forcing a temporary return to manual triage queues.

notable.title: Diy bio assay scare
notable.line: Municipal health IT audits flag several local clinics and university labs using the mirrored open frontier model with the contested genome-model methods to design pathogen assays, triggering police seizures and a press scandal over ungovernable bio-assistance.

notable.title: Sneakernet weight couriers
notable.line: Offline dead-drop networks and refurbished-GPU rental shops spread pre-loaded near-frontier weights to clinics, municipalities and small firms unable to download them directly, widening unrecallable circulation beyond internet metrics.
